hints.translation: Pick the live translation service and add its API key. Languages and voice are chosen on the meeting page.
hints.corpus: Terms, hot words and replacements make names and jargon come out right and consistent. Doubao only for now.
hints.subtitle: Layout, background, size and content of the floating subtitle window.
hints.pricing: The meeting monitor uses these unit prices to estimate each meeting. They start at list price; change them to your contract rates. Stored on this Mac only.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Follows the system locale by default.

doubao.label: Doubao · ByteDance LiveInterpret 2.0
doubao.hint: Voice cloning supported; 8 languages around a Chinese/English hub.

qwen.label: Qwen · Alibaba Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate-Flash
qwen.hint: Auto-detects the source language; voice cloning and 29 spoken output languages; 24 kHz TTS output.

gemini.label: Google Gemini · Live Translate
gemini.hint: Auto-detects the source language and keeps the speaker's voice; 70+ languages. Needs access to Google (uses the system proxy).

openai.label: OpenAI · gpt-realtime-translate
openai.hint: Continuous interpretation; auto-detects the source language and the translated voice follows the speaker. Needs access to OpenAI (uses the system proxy).

translation.engineHint: Stop any active translation before switching.
translation.switchFailed:
Switch failed: {{message}}

Stop the active translation first, then switch.

doubao.label: Doubao API keys
doubao.savedHint: App Key and Access Key are encrypted and stored on this device.
doubao.obtainHint: Find App Key and Access Key in Volcano Engine console under "Speech → LiveInterpret 2.0".

qwen.label: Qwen API key
qwen.savedHint: DashScope API key is encrypted and stored on this device.
qwen.obtainHint: Generate one in the Alibaba Bailian console (Beijing region) under "API-KEY" — starts with sk-. Find the workspace ID under "Workspace management"; with it set, the recommended workspace-dedicated host is used.

gemini.label: Gemini API key
gemini.savedHint: Gemini API key is encrypted and stored on this device.
gemini.obtainHint: Generate one in Google AI Studio under "Get API key" — starts with AIza.

openai.label: OpenAI API key
openai.savedHint: OpenAI API key is encrypted and stored on this device.
openai.obtainHint: Generate one on the OpenAI Platform under "API keys" — starts with sk-. Billed per audio minute (about $0.034/min).

translation.busy: Translation is running. Stop it to switch services.

clearConfirm.title: Clear the {{engine}} key?
clearConfirm.description: You'll need to enter it again before translating with this service.

startStop.label: Start / stop translation
startStop.hint: Press to start, press again or hit Esc to stop.

stopCancel.label: Stop / cancel
stopCancel.hint: Esc terminates the current operation at any time (not configurable).

capture.title: Record a new hotkey
capture.instruction: Press the combination you want to use. Press it once to start translating, then press it again to stop.
capture.supportedHint: Supports modifier + letter / digit / F1-F20 / arrows / Space / Tab. Esc cancels.

errors.unsupportedKey: That key combo isn't supported — try a more common one.

preview.sampleSrc: 看来我们在时间线上达成了一致。让我们推进集成方案吧。
preview.sampleTgt: It seems we're aligned on the timeline. Let's move forward with the integration plan.
preview.earlierSrc: 我们先从发布时间表说起。
preview.earlierTgt: Let's start with the launch timeline.
preview.speakSrc: I think the second week of December is safer.
preview.speakTgt: 我觉得十二月第二周比较稳妥。

layout.label: Two-way layout
layout.hint: When you and the other side are both on: a timeline interleaves who said what in order, which reads best in long meetings; side by side gives each a column.

background.label: Background style
background.hint: Use "Frosted glass" for screen sharing; pick "Transparent" to overlay the screen.

opacity.label: Background opacity
opacity.hintDisabled: Not applied in fully transparent mode.

liveLines.label: Live caption lines
liveLines.hint: How many lines the sentence being spoken normally takes. Longer ones grow upward over the history until they're finished.

source.label: Show source
source.hint: Turn off to read translations only — easier to skim in long meetings. You can also switch it from the subtitle window.

history.label: Keep history in subtitles
history.hint: Show the last few translated lines.

appearance.themeHint: Affects both the main panel and the floating subtitles.

system.label: Match system
system.hint: Follow the macOS light / dark setting.

glossary.hint: Source → target mapping. Guides the model to translate proper nouns your way. e.g. 人工智能 → Machine Learning.

hotWords.hint: Mark source-language words that are likely to appear; improves recognition accuracy.

correctWords.hint: Find / replace applied to the source and translation. e.g. 接受 → 接收.

corpus.tooMany: Over the {{max}}-entry limit. Remove some to save.
corpus.engineUnsupported: Vocabulary only applies to Doubao. You are using {{engine}}; it takes effect once you switch to Doubao.

pricing.intro: Costs are estimates: usage comes from what providers report (Gemini is derived from audio duration), and your provider's bill is what counts. Blank fields are not priced.
pricing.invalid: Prices must be numbers of 0 or more

notes.doubao: Simultaneous Interpretation 2.0, pay-as-you-go list price; audio and text input cost the same. Resource packs bring it down to ¥40–56 per 1M; new accounts get 1M free tokens.
notes.qwen: Beijing region list price. Text input has no listed price and counts as free; other regions (e.g. Singapore) differ.
notes.gemini: Standard tier. Billed on audio only, about 25 tokens per second, derived from the audio actually sent and received.
notes.openai: Billed per minute of audio streamed: $0.034/min for translation plus $0.017/min for the source transcript.
